supportedClaims: Pinned fixed-parameter local numerical observations with persisted input, artifact hashes and Harness execution provenance.
outOfScope: Hardware performance, error-correction thresholds, quantum advantage and correctness proofs of numerical libraries.
Cross-machine bitwise reproducibility and claims outside the bounded numerical audit.

checks.criterion: Hermitian real Pauli model: <=6 qubits, <=64 terms, <=1024 steps, Trotter order 1/2/4 or qDrift; normalized statevector and dense reference required. Computation remains uncapped.
Persisted result satisfies its JSON Schema.
Method, qubits, steps, order and seed match persisted input.
Combine duplicate/cancelled terms and identity independently; coefficient L1 norm matches.
Pauli rotation count exactly matches Trotter formula or qDrift sample budget.
Independent squared state norm equals one within 1e-10.
Dense reference is computed as requested.
OpenQASM gate counts, rotation budget and identity phase agree.
Independent reference consumed exactly the persisted request.
Every gate, wire, angle, depth and resource count matches an independent schedule.
qDrift sequence/counts replay under same NumPy PCG64 runtime; deterministic Trotter needs no seed. Incompatible or unavailable replay remains conditional.
Analytic Pauli evolution reproduces every complex amplitude including phase, tolerance 1e-10 + 1e-8 relative.
Fidelity agrees with independent Hermitian eigendecomposition reference, tolerance 1e-10 + 1e-8 relative.
Full-unitary Frobenius and spectral errors match independent reference, tolerance 1e-10 + 1e-8 relative.
Trotter spectral errors at N,2N,4N obey the conservative Taylor remainder bound capped at 2; qDrift makes no such claim.
Materializer atomically wrote and reread input/artifact bytes; digests and actual Harness call/result event range bind the evidence.
